page.overview:
What is White Sand?

White Sand is a fantasy graphic novel series written by American author Brandon Sanderson and Rik Hothumbskin, with artwork by Julius Gopez initially and later by Fritz Casas. The first part of the trilogy, White Sand Volume I, was published on June 28, 2016.

The second part was released on February 20, 2018. The third and final part will be released in September 2019. Category:Fantasy Category:Cosmere Category:Graphic Novel Category:White Sand
